artifact.signature: APK Signature Scheme v2 verified; development signing only

implemented: Native browsing-data choices, review/confirmation and cancellation before submission
Explicit current-tab/history selection required before any storage request
Runtime-scoped asynchronous controller with overlap rejection and pending-result observation
Paused browsing and closed sessions while a UI clear request is pending
Fresh local Home session after a terminal outcome; no full SessionState restoration
Honest request-completed/not-confirmed status instead of guaranteed-erasure claims

selection_and_storage_contract.validation: A nonempty selection is required. Cache or site-storage choices additionally require the user to select Current tab & history. No unchecked category is silently selected.
selection_and_storage_contract.history_scope: Current tab and its back/forward GeckoSession history only; not an independently maintained global visit-history database
selection_and_storage_contract.close_boundary: Owned browser sessions close before any storage clear request, preventing loaded sites from immediately restoring data
selection_and_storage_contract.engine_result_error_path: Exposed errors complete exceptionally with typed, fixed-message failures; partial effects are disclosed rather than represented as atomic rollback

important_engine_limitation.finding: The pinned GeckoView159 storage bridge discards individual cleaner failure bits before reporting callback completion.
important_engine_limitation.consequence: The public API completion means Gecko finished processing the request, not independent proof that every matching item was removed. Exposed dispatch/runtime errors still propagate.
important_engine_limitation.ui_language: Clear request completed or Clear request not confirmed
important_engine_limitation.native_fixture_scope: The tests below verify selected synthetic items and preservation boundaries, not exhaustive deletion of an arbitrary profile.

excluded_from_controls: Native KixKan account/session preferences and credentials
preserved_and_excluded.actual_preservation_evidence: Test-owned local bookmark and native-preference sentinels remained intact across the native fixtures.

validation.lint: Passed; no check or baseline bypass introduced

native.environment: Owned disposable Android17/API37 emulator, not a physical handset

groups.scope: Read-only APK, intent registration/gates, packaged palette and asset checks
Real engine session/page/history retention and terminal close using a fixed local document
Three actual selective engine-persistence cases plus two real-fixture validation/boundary/busy-guard cases
Visible validation, cancellation/keep-data consent and confirmed history-only reset
Explicitly simulated pending ENGINE_CLEAR failure through two mid-pending Activity recreations; not an actual engine cleanup failure

selective_engine_findings: History-only closes the session while preserving the fixture cookie, localStorage and HTTP cache
Cache selection causes the fixture cached asset to be fetched again while preserving its cookie/localStorage
Cookie/DOM-storage selection removes the fixture cookie/localStorage while preserving its HTTP cache
Invalid selection and a throwing close boundary do not issue a storage request or retry
A second controller for the same runtime is rejected while the first operation is busy, before another close boundary runs
simulated_lifecycle_findings: No live or attached page session opens during either pending recreation
Browsing controls remain disabled and waiting UI is visible
The injected typed failure reaches the active UI as not confirmed, never as completed
Fresh local Home/session recovery occurs only after the injected terminal event
native.simulated_lifecycle_limit: This covers rotation while pending, not persistence of an already-shown terminal error dialog through a later rotation.

remote_ci.android_native_checks: Passed locally as separately recorded; remote Android build not claimed
remote_ci.scope: Existing desktop overlay validation, not an Android build/native test
remote_ci.observed: Eight existing overlay unit tests passed; ShellCheck failed on pre-existing readonly-assignment warnings and attempted to parse systemd/desktop metadata as shell

known_limitations: No independently verified all-item erasure or secure-erasure guarantee; the pinned engine masks individual cleaner failure bits
Only all-time requests are implemented; no date-range filtering
Storage clearing requires explicit current-tab/history closure; preserving open-page/session state during storage clearing is unsupported
Process-death recovery of a pending operation is not implemented; the pending UI/controller state is process-lifetime only
Physical handsets, hardware/carrier behavior and complete accessibility/TalkBack acceptance remain untested
No real production account login, credentials or server-side account behavior was exercised
Developer debug package only, with no production signing, secure update delivery or public APK release
Existing prototype browser limitations outside this privacy milestone remain; this is not a security certification
next_priority: Physical handset and TalkBack testing, process-death privacy behavior, and smaller production-signed packages; no release readiness claim
